interpretation.note: The cost verdict classifies the implemented candidate only. It is NOT informative as a cost-robustness qualification of a genuine momentum edge because bt.momentum_signals is degenerate for 9/10 assets (near-constant +1 exposure; mean log PRICE, not log RETURN). A near-constant long book has essentially one entry trade, so transaction cost cannot erode it; the COST_ROBUST verdict reflects that, not a genuine edge's cost tolerance. A genuine momentum signal and its cost sensitivity remain UNVERIFIED pending repair of momentum_signals / mean_reversion_signals.
